value: New script layout: `scripts/sb-<name>/sb-<name>.sh`, `#!/bin/sh`, defines a single function `sb_<name>()` (underscore in function, hyphen in path). Errors go to stderr (`>&2`); user-facing info to stdout. Validate inputs with `grep -Eq` regex (POSIX-safe) instead of `[[ =~ ]]`. If the script needs to *run* something on source (not just define a function), tag it with `# sb-shell: auto-run`. Document any expected user alias in the README rather than baking it in.
